title_sq: Tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, Shitet Apartament 3+1, Me Super Pamje Dhe Investim!
description_sq: Ne nje nga komplekset me te mira ne Tirane, tek Rezidenca Kodra e Diellit 2, shitet super apartament 3+1+2, i sapoinvestuar. Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 3 te nje pallati 4 katesh te mireadministruar me ashensor te ndertuar ne vitin 2015 dhe organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje te bollshem se bashku me ambientin e gatimit dhe me dalje ne ballkon, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me dalje ne ballkon dhe me tualetin e saj te dedikuar, dy dhoma te bollshme femijesh dhe tualetin kryesore. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i investuar nga pronari duke filluar qe nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike te cilat jane multistrad te reja, parketin i cili eshte AC5, vetratat duplex me gaz argon te cilat mundesojne pervec izolimit akustik gjithashtu dhe nje izolim termik qe bere bashke me faktin qe apartamenti ka sistem kapot ofron temperatura sa me optimale ne apartament. Gjithashtu ne sallon eshte dhe oxhaku, me sistem ngrohje ne cdo dhome. Apartamenti eshte totalisht i mobiluar ku perfshiihet salloni i ndenjes bashke me oxhakun, ambienti i gatimit, tre dhomat si dhe te dy tualetet. Apartamenti te gjitha investim dhe punimet e gipsit i ka te kryera me arkitekt dhe jane te kompozuar ne menyren me te mire te mundshme. Orientimi eshte nga Lindja cka e ben nje apartament te ekspozuar ndaj drites se diellit ne pjesen me te mire te dites gjithashtu ka dhe pamje te lire nga qyteti dhe mali i Dajtit. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nje zone e cila eshte shume e kerkuar pasi ofron te gjitha sherbimet e nevojshme per nje jetese sa me komode, me ajer te paster dhe nje zone mjaft e qete. Kompleksi aksesohet dhe nga linja e transportit publik qe te sjelle deri tek hyrja e rezidences. Apartamenti pervec faktit qe eshte shume i pershtatshem per banim eshte shume i pershtatshem edhe per investim pasi zona ka kerkesa te larta qeraje. Aktualisht eshte i dhene me qera 900 euro.
title_en: At Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, Apartment 3+1 for sale, with great view and investment!
description_en: In one of the best complexes in Tirana, at Residence Kodra e Diellit 2, a super apartment 3+1+2, newly invested, is for sale. The apartment is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed 4-story building with an elevator built in 2015 and is organized in a spacious living room together with a kitchen area with access to the balcony, a master bedroom with access to the balcony and its own dedicated toilet, two spacious children's rooms and the main toilet. The apartment is totally invested by the owner, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations which are new multistrad, the parquet which is AC5, the duplex windows with argon gas which enable, in addition to acoustic insulation, also a thermal insulation which, together with the fact that the apartment has a capot system, offers the most optimal temperatures in the apartment. There is also a fireplace in the living room, with a heating system in every room. The apartment is fully furnished, including the living room with the fireplace, the kitchen, the three bedrooms and the two toilets. The apartment has all investment and plaster works done by an architect and they are composed in the best possible way. The orientation is from the East, which makes the apartment exposed to sunlight for the best part of the day, and also has a clear view of the city and the mountain of Dajti. The area in which the apartment is located is an area that is very sought after as it offers all the necessary services for a comfortable life, with clean air and a quite quiet area. The complex is also accessed by the public transport line that brings you to the entrance of the residence. Apart from the fact that it is very suitable for living, the apartment is also very suitable for investment as the area has high rent requirements. It is currently rented for 900 euros.
